subtitle: From survival to Tek Cave and ascension

sections.title: The Island · story map
items: The starting map of ARK's journey, with Explorer Notes/Dossiers and an ascension route. Fight the three guardians separately, then pass through Tek Cave to Overseer.

ASA species in the registry include Acrocanthosaurus, Archelon, Ceratosaurus, Cryolophosaurus, Deinosuchus, Deinotherium, Gigantoraptor, and Helicoprion. Do not treat Evolved Tek creatures as normal ASA spawns.

sections.title: Terrain & biome
items: The southern coast suits early progression; central forests and Redwoods require caution around predators, Thylacoleo, and travel routes.
The northern snows, mountains and Volcano have resources but require suitable gear/mounts. Swamps are dangerous with torpor, leech and ambush creatures.
The Dead Island (Carno Island) in the northeast has route Devourer; The sea on both sides contains cave Brute / Cunning and underwater resources.

sections.title: Resources & logistics
items: Suggestion: prepare metal/crystal/obsidian mountain routes; get an Argentavis and harvesting tame before industrial expansion.
Pearls/oils and marine artifacts require SCUBA, repair tools and marine tame. Harvest/warehouse/crafting groups should be located close together; Leave space for shipping from the flyer.

sections.title: Dino theo The Island
items: The Island has Rhyniognatha, Unicorn, Polar Bear and Yeti. There is no Wyvern or natural Griffin.
Polar Bear/Yeti and cave variants have distinct taming rules; species-stat profiles do not imply every Feral cave creature is tameable. Alphas are separate, untameable variants.

sections.title: 10 artifact · 10 route + Tek Cave
items: Broodmother: Hunter, Clever, Massive. Megapithecus: Brute, Devourer, Pack. Dragon: Cunning, Immune, Skylord, Strong.
Artifact routes span land, snow/swamp, and two ocean caves. Item GPS comes from the Ascended layer; do not replace it with old Evolved GPS.

Tek Cave has no artifact to collect for summoning Overseer: it requires trophies from the three guardians at the correct difficulty, plus Alpha drops at higher tiers. This is the final expedition, not a practice cave.

sections.title: 4 boss & ascension
items: Single Player: Broodmother in Green Obelisk; Megapithecus in Blue; Dragon is in Red. Read the correct level/tribute for each level in Boss.
The three guardians award Element/Tekgrams and trophies; Overseer drops no Element. Defeat Overseer to ascend and raise the level cap by +5/+10/+15 according to difficulty.
Do not take the HP/loot of the double battle The Center as the standard for the single battle The Island. Single Player settings affect strength; need to check timer/gate in save.

sections.title: Explorer Notes & Dossiers
items: Explore Explorer Notes to follow the storyline and gain XP.
Read Explorer Notes in the game before leveling to take advantage of the XP boost.

sections.title: Base suggestion · The Island
items: Start small near the south coast, water and materials; Avoid opening a base in the middle of a swamp or close to a predator if you don't have a mount.
The main base should have access to the mountain, breeding area and industrial warehouse; Arrange training ground/boss squad near commonly used Obelisk route, keep replacements at home.
Supply hut outside the cave entrance, not built to block artifacts or nodes. Team Tek Cave needs a squad practice area before the final trip.

sections.title: Suggested route · The Island
items: Phase 1–2: survival → stone/metal tools → flyer, harvester and electricity/crafting. Phase 3: cave kits and ocean tames, collect all artifact sets.
Phase 4: breed/imprint, saddle and support equipment; Hit three guardians Gamma, raise Beta / Alpha according to target and actual results.

Phase 5: collect trophy of the same level + Alpha drops, prepare team Tek Cave/ Overseer, survey lava and teleporter. Keep a save copy before the ascension trip; Do not mix trophies of different levels when calculating tribute.

sections.title: Single Player · platform for correct calculation
items: Record Difficulty, Maximum Difficulty, Use Singleplayer Settings, taming/breeding rates, resource respawn, and all mods before planning. These are input conditions; another server's stats are not the standard for your save.

Suggestion: keep settings stable, record after each change. The goal of a phase should be specific completion conditions: enough machines, enough equipment, enough tame and the exit route has been surveyed.
Creature levels and locations may change according to world and mod settings.

sections.title: Read maps & coordinates
items: LAT increases southward and LON eastward. Artifact marks the collection point; cave entrance marks the approach. Nearby points have a selection menu; use the Artifact / Cave entrance / Boss layers separately.
On The Island, mini-map coordinates may differ from waypoints. Identify more terrain when searching for the cave entrance.
Cave entrance coordinates are community guidance and may vary with version or standing position. Area/reference points are not exact entrances. The map shows surface terrain, not cave floors.
